definition: Highest METR 80%-success time horizon (human task length, minutes) of any publicly evaluated model as of the obs date (METR benchmark_results.yaml)

Release-cohort METR 80%-success time horizon (human task length, minutes): the highest point estimate among models RELEASED on or before the obs date (model release_date), per the METR evaluation vintage retrieved (benchmark_results_1_1.yaml; later METR re-estimates are appended as revisions). Not the frontier as publicly evaluated at that date: METR evaluations appear after release
